Most appreciated
Sep 2026 • Solo
This is my second trip to Madame Lam in just a few days. I stumbled on this restaurant and immediately was impressed with the quality of the food, cleanliness, atmosphere and service. 
My server, Vy was very attentive and answered all of my questions. 
I would like to note that I don’t give out praise without good reason. The value compared to the quality is a definite plus. 
Returning to this establishment was a no brainer and it’s a 20+ ride each way from my hotel. I simply appreciate the all around positive experience and good dining without the upsell or other hassles. 

Thank you!
